answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com article published 2026-07-01 reporting an NN, Inc. announcement made in late June 2026; the exact announcement day is not stated in the source, and the underlying NN press release was not reviewed.
answer.note: Material source claim: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. The article reports that 100% of the new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and NN targeted US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026 from the expansion. For NVIDIA (the covered company), this supports a conditional reading that NVIDIA-rack liquid cooling supply is being expanded in NN's Wuxi plant and that NN's own disclosures point to contracted demand for it. It does not show that NVIDIA is a direct purchaser of NN's output, that NVIDIA placed the awards, or that NVIDIA's own orders, revenue or margins changed. The NVIDIA link rests on the article's framing and NN's stated end market, so the evidence supports a supply-chain and capacity signal, not a customer-revenue fact. The US$80-90 million figure is NN's own 2026 business target (a party statement), and the 100% pre-sold status is NN's own claim as reported. The 2028 revenue and earnings projections (narrative and unnamed analysts) concern NN's financial model, not NVIDIA, and are not used. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal concerns NN's trading and index membership and does not bear on NVIDIA. The article's marketing content and dividend and quantum-computing promotions carry no evidence for NVIDIA.
limitations: The source does not identify the award counterparties; the link to NVIDIA rests on the article's description of the racks as NVIDIA AI data center racks.
No contract values, volumes, signing dates or delivery schedules for the pre-sold awards are disclosed, so the timing and size of any demand are unknown.
The US$80-90 million 2026 target is NN's own forward target from the announcement and does not show realized revenue.
The 100% pre-sold status is NN's claim as reported in a media article; no primary NN filing was reviewed.
The original announcement day is not stated, so the exact statement date is unknown beyond late June 2026.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's late-June 2026 press release or 8-K and check for named award counterparties, contract terms, signing dates and delivery timing for the 47 machine centers.
Check NVIDIA's most recent 10-Q or 10-K supplier and rack-level disclosures for any mention of liquid cooling suppliers, Asia rack assembly or NN.
Check whether NVIDIA or its rack assemblers have announced liquid cooling capacity or rack ramp timing that matches the Wuxi expansion window.
